diligent.title: The Soul of the Diligent is Richly Supplied 🌱
diligent.body: End the day with diligence! Plant a seed of careful planning now, so you can richly sow tomrrow

ant.title: You don't have to be strong to be prepared 🐜
ant.body: The ant isn't strong, but it prepares in the time of preparation. When the Winter comes, it will have enough!

widow.title: Trust God with All Your Money 🪙
widow.body: The strongest showcase of faith, is knowing how much you have, and letting God freely use it, just like the Widow.
